scheme_name: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme
other_conditions: Institute must be located in Goa
Institute must be affiliated with a recognized public university
Preference will be given to well‑performing applicants
Institutes cannot restrict incubation facilities only to their own students
Benefits are not an entitlement; SPC may accept or reject applications
Eligibility of expenses determined by Accounting Standard 102 for Fixed Assets
Application can be made any time of the financial year but only within 6 months of incurring the relevant expenditure
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,00,000 one‑time grant for capital expenses to set up incubators, and up to ₹3,00,000 per year for three years for operational expenses for existing facilities.
